programs.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
programs.desc: The team dives in search of an A3 Skywarrior attack aircraft that was lost in a suspicious disaster off the USS Saratoga aircraft carrier in 1960. The Saratoga lost eight men on this single mission.

programs.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programs.desc: Buckle up as we take you on a wild journey into the world of vintage daredevils who risked it all for a rush. From the enigmatic Human Fly to skateboard speed demons, these stunts were unforgettable.

programs.title: 1942: Philippine Resistance: Refusal To Surrender
programs.desc: Gen MacArthur famously promised that 'I shall return' before retreating but this was possible only with Filipino guerrillas bravely fighting on.

programs.title: Hidden Cities

programs.title: The Death Coast

programs.title: Swamp People
programs.desc: As the season hits full stride, alligators begin changing their behaviours-and the hunters must adjust to stay ahead. Joey and Zak swap their trademark weapons to see who can nab the biggest bulls.
